# Referred Projects

## Microduck of Pollen-robotics

- Duck itself: [pollen-robotics/microduck: A Tiny biped duck robot 🦆](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck)

- RL training environments: [pollen-robotics/microduck_rl: RL training environments for Microduck (mjlab)](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck_rl)

- Website: [Microduck: a tiny biped robot you can teach new tricks](https://pollen-robotics.com/microduck/)

## Microduck of HD1910M

- Microduck: [zhuoligetu123/microduck-hd1910m: Radxa ZERO 3W + 飞特 HD1910M ×15 + BNO08x。包含行走、拾取、起身、翻滚四模型适配、Rust 后端/底层、RL 训练与 MuJoCo 仿真源码；客户端APK。 MicroDuck HD1910M native runtime, RL integration, deployment and APK release](https://github.com/zhuoligetu123/microduck-hd1910m)

## Xgoduck

- Hardware: [LuwuDynamics/xgoduck_hardware: Build your own robot duck. XGO-Duck is a 3D-printable biped powered by Arduino UNO Q and 15 servos, adapted from Pollen Robotics' Microduck. Includes mechanical models, PCB designs, a BOM, and an assembly guide. Build it, explore its motion, and make it your own.](https://github.com/LuwuDynamics/xgoduck_hardware)

- RL training environments: [LuwuDynamics/xgoduck_rl](https://github.com/LuwuDynamics/xgoduck_rl)

- Website: [XGO-Duck 双足机器鸭｜整机套件开售 · 基础款即将售罄](https://www.xgorobot.com/duck.html)
